title: Alert
description: Message published on the Redis channel 'alerts' by the detector.

timestamp.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of the detection.

severity.description: Severity bucket assigned by the detector.

error_rate.description: Fraction of ERROR-level lines in the current window.

baseline_mean.description: Mean error rate over the baseline period.

baseline_std.description: Standard deviation of the baseline error rate.

z_score.description: How many std deviations error_rate is from baseline_mean.

window_seconds.description: Length of the detection window in seconds.
